messages:
alex: FYI noticed a spike in /v1/embeddings tail latency around 02:10 UTC. quick trace shows mixed-dim large batches falling through to slow quantized path and causing head-of-line delays.

maria: ugh. any particular tenant or model?

jordan: mostly tenants sending mixes of 768 and 2048 dims in same request. splitter gives up and we route each vector individually -> lots of tiny requests that trip the slowpath.

alex: result: a cascade of retries + 413s downstream which worsens queue depth. p99 jumped from ~400ms to >2.5s for the route.

sam: can the console surface which tenants are hitting the slowpath prior to this? we only alerted on global route latency.

alex: that's the ask. we need a per-tenant signal: preflight failure rate + in-flight queue depth. if both high, we should fast-fail or steer to a bounded fallback.

maria: idea: tenant-scoped ingress "circuit" that trips on combined preflight mismatch rate and high p99. On trip, either fastfail with a clear error telling client to split, or route to a fallback with strict quota to avoid overload.

jordan: prefer soft degrade first: response header suggestion to split + Retry-After. Avoid immediate hard failures unless it continues.

lee: telemetry requirements: emit dims_histogram (per-request), vector_count, payload_bytes, preflight_outcome (ok/mixed/oversize), path_taken (fastpath/splitter/slowpath/fallback), circuit_status (closed/open/gray).

alex: sample telemetry payload: ```
X-Embed-Client-Hint: dims=[768,2048];count=132
vector_count:132
total_bytes:1048576
preflight: mixed-dims
route: slowpath
circuit: closed
```

dave: SDK UX: add an optional advisory header clients can send to reduce server parse costs: X-Embed-Client-Hint with dims and count. server still validates but can short-circuit heavy parsing.

maria: circuit thresholds proposal: trip if preflight_mismatch_rate > 8% AND rolling p99 > 2s for 5m. untrip after 10m stable below thresholds. start canary at 5% tenants.

jordan: tests: unit test for threshold math, integration sim for mixed-dim streams, and chaos test to ensure fallback doesn't thrash. create a load test with 100k vector payloads to validate behavior.

sam: console: need per-tenant widget: circuit state timeline, counts of fastfail vs fallback, top offending dims combos, and a one-click "force close" / "disable fallback" for support. Also an alert link to open runbook.

lee: telemetry retention: keep raw preflight events for 7d; aggregated histograms (hourly/daily) retained 90d. add saved search: top tenants by fallback_ratio.

alex: rollout plan: phase A emit telemetry only (2w). phase B enable soft-degrade header for 5% tenants. phase C enable strict fallback/quota and expose controls in console.

maria: contract change: preflight_mode header where clients can choose 'basic' or 'full'. 'full' returns explicit split_hint in response body; default remains 'basic'. document in SDK changelog.

jordan: also watch parsing CPU. some clients send base64-encoded nested arrays; preflight parsing can be heavy. advisory header will help.

dave: add response header X-Embed-Suggest-Split:true and field split_hint=per-tenant to help clients automate splitting.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate alex/ingress-circuit -> staging started (build 87).

lee: telemetry enums should be stable strings for dashboard filters: path_taken: ["fastpath","splitter","slowpath","fallback_strict","fallback_soft"]. circuit_status: ["closed","open","degraded"].

alex: add quota_signal: ["none","soft","strict"] emitted when circuit changes. strip headers from logs to avoid leaking tenant ids.

maria: ops checklist: feature flag config, alert rules for per-tenant trip_count, dashboard tiles, runbook, SDK changelog, migration notes.

jordan: i'll add infra-tests harness and a script simulating mixed dims to infra-tests repo.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate alex/ingress-circuit -> staging succeeded (build 87).

alex: staging telemetry looks sane. mixed-dim requests are small fraction (~0.6%) but responsible for ~38% of p99 latency.

maria: that's compelling. agree to proceed to canary next week unless objections.

sam: i'll prep console mock and canary config. Friday sync to review flags.

alex: will open follow-up thread with canary results and runbook once live.
